answer: The falcon multiplier is published, charged in crystal, and forge lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 6 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 3237 identities would post 2354 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
